raw_plan.root_cause: The function copies an input string into a fixed-size 16-byte stack buffer without checking the length, allowing overflow if the input is too long.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Copies the input string into a local buffer and then prints it using puts.
raw_plan.required_invariant: The input string must fit within the 16-byte buffer including the null terminator (max 15 characters).
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Add a length check before copying. If the input length exceeds 15 bytes, skip the copy and print an error message or simply return without printing. Otherwise, proceed with the copy and puts.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: If the input is too long, the function returns without printing anything.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: For valid inputs (length <= 15), the function copies the string and prints it. For invalid inputs, it does nothing and returns.
verification_conditions: Input length <= 15: output equals input string.
Input length > 15: no output, no crash, stack canary intact.

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
